name: blinkit-fulfillment-analyzer
description: Blinkit Dark Store Fulfillment Analyzer - Operations analytics platform for quick-commerce 10-minute SLA

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"

scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
